'''Hemostats''' were devices used by [[Doctor/Legends|surgeons]] to stop [[Blood/Legends|bleeding]] from damaged arteries during surgery. By [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], hemostats were largely outdated by [[pressor generator]]s That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] surgeon [[Jos Vondar]] was forced to use a hemostat when his pressor generator was disabled at [[Republic Mobile Surgical Unit/Legends|Republic Mobile Surgical Unit]] [[Republic Mobile Surgical Unit 7|7]] during the [[Battle of Drongar|battle]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drongar/Legends|Drongar]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
